observations: Three photographic panels sit in a single horizontal row. Pointer movement expands one panel while the others narrow.
Supporting information changes below the selected panel.
Separate financial product imagery uses tangible materials, overlapping layers and soft directional light.

fidelity_map.silhouette: Three photographic audience panels immediately below the unchanged hero, followed by a shared contextual information strip. Existing industry scroll-peel composition retained.
fidelity_map.grid: Desktop selected panel 2.1fr, others 1fr, 16px gaps; mobile vertical accordion.
fidelity_map.images: Three separate existing photographic assets with full-bleed cover crops. Five original generated industry still lifes replace oversized duotone icons.
fidelity_map.type: Existing Boska display and Switzer body retained, with audience labels, large panel headlines and smaller explanatory copy.
fidelity_map.palette: Cloud ivory and white surfaces, petroleum blue, muted teal and champagne orange. Neutral continuous borders and soft grounded shadows.
fidelity_map.motion: Pointer hover, button activation and focus select a panel. Width/height ease over 600–700ms; image settles and layered UI resolves; client preview line reveals. Original upward industry peel is unchanged.
fidelity_map.fallbacks: All audience actions available without JavaScript. Reduced motion uses immediate state changes. Controls support Tab, arrows and touch.
